checks.name: Initial state never enters; invalid totals/counters cannot manufacture readiness
Adversarial order of job/resource/scene milestones never permits premature entry
Nested resource starts and late resources revoke ready until balanced completion
Ready never auto-enters and explicit/reentrant enter callback runs once
Any failure is terminal even if all jobs/resources finish, with deduplicated diagnostics
Snapshots and notifications are immutable independent values
Opaque initial overlay outside inert aria-hidden app with accessible explicit entry button
Resources/jobs gate preparation; compile and full render precede sceneReady; entry enables controls
Dynamic import failures and stalled load expose failure; retry reloads instead of bypassing gate
Three reference-sized gears and decorative loading phrases preserve an accessible white entry pill
Continuous animation starts only on explicit campus entry after prepared render
Actual UI stays gated until click, ready focuses entry, enter releases inert and retry reloads
Post-entry failure re-gates the app, focuses retry and cannot re-enter

limitations: Pure state, fake-DOM UI and static integration checks only; no browser render/accessibility interaction or network loading verification.
